_comment: Source (English) bundle for vscode.l10n.t(...) host strings. Keys are the English source strings; the editor uses these verbatim for English and looks up bundle.l10n.<locale>.json for other display languages. Normally auto-extracted by @vscode/l10n-dev; maintained by hand here.
What do you need? Claude matches your as: What do you need? Claude matches your ask to the right context & tools in your AIOS — and puts them to work
e.g. 'prep tomorrow's investor call' · ': e.g. 'prep tomorrow's investor call' · 'post about our launch'
One or more sources — URLs, file paths,: One or more sources — URLs, file paths, or a topic (blank to be guided)
For sessions started from your vault; se: For sessions started from your vault; separate from Glass's language
AIOS Glass: could not save Claude's lang: AIOS Glass: could not save Claude's language
Saved. Claude's own settings still say {: Saved. Claude's own settings still say {lang}, so it keeps answering in it
Should Claude answer in the language you: Should Claude answer in the language you write in again?
Glass is in {lang} now. Should Claude an: Glass is in {lang} now. Should Claude answer in {lang} too?
AIOS Glass: there is no note for today y: AIOS Glass: there is no note for today yet. Planning your day writes it.
AIOS Glass: there is no note for that da: AIOS Glass: there is no note for that day.
